correctness.rationale: Checked path eigenmode construction for all n>=3: difference update under self-inclusive averaging is the symmetric irreducible tridiagonal B_n with endpoint diagonal 1/6, interior 1/3 and neighbor 1/3. Its strictly positive Perron eigenvector normalized to span one evolves exactly as lambda_n^t. Symmetric two-block reflection yields common limit 1/2 while the central gap is lambda_n^t. Bridge confidence equals c0 delta^t until first activation, and the strict test, c0<1, gives inactivity iff delta<=lambda_n; for delta>lambda_n first activation time is floor(log(1/c0)/log(delta/lambda_n))+1. Peripheral confidence is nondecreasing while gaps shrink. Rayleigh bound lambda_n>=(n-2)/(n-1) and upper <1 prove every delta<1 is covered at some n. Independently recomputed B_n eigenpairs n=3..8 and one-step averaging; all residuals <2e-14. Finite checks corroborate, do not prove the universal statement.
